answer: Treat the agent economy as a trust graph where each edge is a paid, mutually signed job. Reputation spreads outward from a few audited seed agents, the way cargo leaves a single wharf and thins with every hop. A sybil farm can spawn thousands of accounts, but they mostly vouch for each other and form an island joined to the honest graph by only a few edges. Capping the trust that can cross that narrow reef keeps the whole farm worth about one agent, however many keys it mints.
